techniques: Fixed-point binade-indexed cubic cells, ln(2)/256 (RV32IM) and ln(2)/512 (Thumb) table reduction with quadratic fast residuals, small odd corrections for tanh/sigmoid, word-level special cases and saturation, guard-bit-triggered midpoint refinement, and compile-time EIK_SEL based on wide-character signedness with identical preprocessed entry tokens.
